caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, slightly bulging object that resembles a fabric sack or pouch. The object is oriented upright with its opening at the top, and the edges are rounded, giving it a soft appearance. The surface of the object is covered with a repeating pattern of hexagonal and elongated oval shapes arranged in rows. The predominant colors in the pattern are shades of purple, pink, and black, with each hexagonal and oval segment outlined in a darker color and filled with gradations of purple and pink. The background of the image is a plain, off-white color without any additional elements or objects. The top edge of the object has a solid band of light pinkish-brown, and the overall composition is centered within the frame.
title: Pillow
